# Time.is

> > Accurate world clock and timezone conversion service providing real-time information for cities worldwide including San Jose, Tehran, Tokyo, Beijing, Paris, London, and New York.

Time.is offers precise current time displays, timezone conversions, and event scheduling tools across all global time zones. The service supports historical time lookups, sunrise/sunset data, and UTC offset calculations for coordinating international meetings and events.

## Key Topics

- World clock
- Timezone conversion
- Pacific Time
- UTC offset
- Event scheduling
- Current time lookup
- Iran Standard Time
- Sunrise and sunset times
- International time zones
- Meeting coordination
- Historical time conversion
- Time zone comparison
- Chile time
- Tehran time
- Real-time synchronization

## Time Conversion Tools

- [Timezone Converter](https://time.is/uk/compare): Compare and convert times across different time zones worldwide
- [Chile Time Conversion](https://time.is/19:30+in+Chile): Convert specific times to Chile timezone with detailed offset information

## World Clock - Major Cities

- [Tehran, Iran Current Time](https://test.time.is/Tehran): Real-time clock for Tehran with Iran Standard Time, sunrise/sunset data

## Event Scheduling & Meeting Times

- [CNCF Security TAG Meeting](https://time.is/1000_today_in_PT?CNCF_Security_TAG_Meeting): Scheduled meeting time converter for CNCF Security TAG at 10:00 Pacific Time
- [Intl WG Meeting - August 2015](https://time.is/0900AM_11_Aug_2015_in_PT?Intl_WG): Historical meeting time reference for Intl WG on August 11, 2015 in Pacific Time
